exposure: Routine antibiotic prophylaxis before elective cesarean section
Single intraoperative intravenous injection of 1 g cefazolin sodium after fetus extraction
outcome: Signs of infectious complications from uterus or other organs
cohort: 333 women who underwent elective cesarean section operations between 2017 and 2019, comprising 118 healthy patients without routine antibiotic prophylaxis and 215 women who received intraoperative antibiotic prophylaxis.
finding: No significant differences were found in the course and number of complications in the postpartum period between patients who received routine antibiotic prophylaxis and those who did not.
